mechanism: Deterministic cross-sectional 20d/60d volatility-normalized residual trend with a smaller 3d reversal component that fades continuously as broad direction strengthens; diversified two-sided construction with a small directional sleeve tilt.
economic_thesis: Slow-moving flows and heterogeneous reaction speeds create intermediate relative continuation, while transient liquidity pressure creates short reversal chiefly in non-directional markets. Long relative winners should carry bull, short relative losers bear, and balanced trend/reversal sleeves chop.

expected_regime_roles.bull: Long persistent relative winners contribute positively; smooth net tilt modestly favors the long sleeve while shorts remain active.
expected_regime_roles.bear: Short persistent relative losers contribute positively; smooth net tilt modestly favors the short sleeve while longs remain active in resilient names.
expected_regime_roles.chop: The reversal component rises toward 20% and balanced sleeves express cross-sectional mean reversion; combined return must be positive.
expected_regime_roles.stress: Signal dispersion may persist, but frozen volatility targeting, drawdown brakes, stops, and turnover limits must contain exposure; official worst-regime floor remains mandatory.
expected_regime_roles.long_sleeve: Top quartile causal scores, diversified and capped; required to be positive in bull.
expected_regime_roles.short_sleeve: Bottom quartile causal scores, diversified and capped; required to be positive in bear.

falsifier: Falsify if the preregistered base fails any official or Team-05 hard development gate, any causal/reproducibility test, any required sleeve/regime role, doubled-cost viability, five-of-six fold profitability, or six-of-eight one-axis neighbor profitability with median neighbor Sharpe at least 0.55.

parameter_ranges.neighborhood_design: Base plus exactly eight preregistered one-axis moves listed in parameter_neighborhood.json; no Cartesian grid and no replacement neighbors.

selection_metric: Binary noncompensatory rule: freeze team05-crtr-base-v1 only if every official and Team-05 hard gate, including the full predeclared neighborhood, passes. Neighbors are stability probes and cannot replace the base.
risk_policy_plan: Fixed combined policy: 18% 30d volatility target with [0.35,1] scale; drawdown scales 0.75/0.50/0.25/0 at 10%/16%/22%/28%; close-confirmed 12% position stop with six-bar cooldown; 0.18 one-way turnover cap; no time stop or side scaling; no same-boundary reentry. Evaluate no-control, each active control alone, and combined at base and doubled costs.
